messages.content: The airline just moved my Friday return to 5:40 p.m. That will not work because the museum handoff is now confirmed for 6:30. Please find something later Friday, or Saturday morning if that is the only sensible option.

I found two nonstop replacements to Atlanta. Friday has a 10:10 p.m. departure from O’Hare, arriving at 1:05 a.m., for an additional $64. Saturday has an 8:35 a.m. departure from O’Hare, arriving at 11:31 a.m., for an additional $22. Both are standard economy and preserve the existing outbound.
How tight would the Friday flight be if the handoff runs until 7:00?

Leaving the museum around 7:00 would give you roughly three hours before departure. With an estimated 45 to 70 minutes to O’Hare, that is workable, though traffic or a delayed handoff could reduce the margin.
The Saturday flight sounds less exposed. Is there anything around 9:30 instead, and would I need another hotel night?

There is a 9:40 a.m. nonstop from O’Hare arriving in Atlanta at 12:36 p.m. The fare difference is $31. You would not need to extend the hotel: the Silversmith reservation already runs through Saturday, October 18, so you can stay Friday night and check out before leaving for the airport.
Use the 9:40 Saturday flight. Please confirm the change and make sure the 5:40 Friday segment is removed.

The return has been changed to Saturday, October 18 at 9:40 a.m., nonstop from O’Hare to Atlanta, arriving at 12:36 p.m. The displaced 5:40 p.m. Friday segment has been removed, and the additional airfare is $31.
And the outbound and hotel are untouched?

Yes. The Tuesday outbound arriving at O’Hare at 9:35 a.m. remains unchanged. The Silversmith reservation is still October 14 through October 18 for four nights, so no lodging adjustment or extra night is required.

updated_continuity_summary: Avery’s Atlanta-Chicago museum work trip runs October 14-18. Her four-night flexible reservation at the Silversmith Hotel remains confirmed for October 14-18 at $1,087 including taxes, with free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Chicago time on October 12. Avery is the primary guest and billing contact, and her wife is listed as the second occupant. The hotel is an 8- to 10-minute walk from the museum staff entrance.
